description: This file is the main implementation of the 'git' command-line interface, handling command parsing, command execution, alias expansion, and external command invocation within the Git version control system.

methods.name: list_builtins
methods.description: Populates a list with available built-in git commands, optionally filtering by include or exclude options.

methods.name: load_builtin_commands
methods.description: Loads commands with a specific prefix into a command list.

methods.name: handle_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and sets environment variables or internal flags accordingly.

methods.name: handle_alias
methods.description: Expands command aliases, detects loops, and modifies argument list.

methods.name: run_builtin
methods.description: Executes a built-in command, handling setup, environment, and output validation.

methods.name: execv_dashed_external
methods.description: Executes external git commands with a 'git-' prefix.

methods.name: is_deprecated_command
methods.description: Checks if a command is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: run_argv
methods.description: Main loop for processing command arguments, handling aliases, built-ins, and external commands.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git' command-line tool, handling initial argument parsing, command dispatch, and error reporting.
